title: Proxima Habitat
inspect_text: Orbital city hub. Docking lanes are open; customs wave you through on transponder.

title: Proxima Jump Gate
inspect_text: Unspace translation ring. Select a known route to translate.

title: Beacon 1
inspect_text: Nav marker: inner orbit lane. Traffic is light.

title: Beacon 2
inspect_text: Nav marker: mid orbit. Freight tugs pass here on the hour.

title: Beacon 3
inspect_text: Nav marker: outer orbit. Something dark is drifting nearby — check your scanner.

title: Derelict Wreck
inspect_text: Broken scout hull. Transponder dead. Salvage looks viable.

title: Bela Orbital Habitat
inspect_text: Resort orbital city. Docking lanes are open; the water-world gleams below.

title: Bela Jump Gate
inspect_text: Unspace translation ring. Known routes lead back toward Proxima and beyond.

title: Beacon 1
inspect_text: Nav marker: resort approach lane. Yacht traffic is steady.

title: Beacon 2
inspect_text: Nav marker: outer lagoon orbit. A drifting pleasure craft passes by.

title: Drift Wreck
inspect_text: Capsized pleasure skiff. Salvage looks viable if you can reach it.

title: Exit Portal
inspect_text: Stabilised portal leading back toward 3-space. Translate through to complete the jump.

title: Entry Drift
inspect_text: Translation wake from 3-space. The exit portal lies deeper in the shear field.

title: Shear Marker
inspect_text: Nav marker: N-space shear intensifies ahead. Stay sharp.
